text:
samir: FYI we just had a DSAR job report 7 records in state=partial_delete. KMS logs show 'Permission denied' followed by a few successful decrypts. looks like intermittent RBAC.

zoe: did any infra changes go out overnight?

infra-bot: Config change: 2026-03-21T01:05:00Z terraform apply by svc:infra-garden@cicd changed binding: removed roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from serviceAccount:erasure-worker@redwood-prod.

samir: that explains the denied errors. but curious why some decrypts succeeded afterwards. could be different worker SA or cached creds.

zoe: check audit logs for SetIamPolicy and decrypt calls. we need to correlate job ids with decrypt protoPayload.request.metadata.

samir: pulling job logs. DSAR job id dsar-7742. Decrypt errors at 1788888892, then success at 1788888930 from same host but different sa: serviceAccount:erasure-worker-retry@redwood-prod.

ciso-karla: legal/impact: if tombstones were not fully applied we may need to notify requesters. also want assurance no plaintext leaked. We Need a timeline and remediation steps.

legal-michelle: please gather subject_request_ids for the 7 items and store evidence bundle. we'll draft notification if required.

erasure-bot: dsar-7742 progress: 7/7 attempted; 5 deleted, 2 tombstone_pending. failures show decrypt error: permission denied (IAM).

zoe: mitigation plan: 1) restore cryptoKeyDecrypter role for erasure-worker SA (short window), 2) re-run tombstone-only pass for affected IDs, 3) collect decrypt logs + access checksums, 4) replace SA access with keystore-proxy flow and revoke role.

samir: agree. long-term: erasure service should never bail on first decrypt failure. add retry logic with exponential backoff and move items to dead-letter after X attempts, flagged for manual review. also add per-request correlation id to decrypt logs for faster audits.

infra-bot: role restored 1788888920 by svc:infra-oncall@pager. Binding: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter added for serviceAccount:erasure-worker@redwood-prod.

erasure-bot: dsar-7742 tombstone pass started at 1788888945 job=reap-1788. attempting 2 pending items.

erasure-bot: reap-1788 status: completed 1788889008. 2/2 succeeded. tombstone state confirmed.

samir: re-run confirmed. updating ledger entries and attaching KMS audit snippets to evidence bundle. no decrypts show plaintext dump in logs.

legal-michelle: thanks. draft customer message: "We detected an internal configuration change that temporarily prevented completion of your deletion request for a small subset of records. We have since completed the deletion and confirmed no data exposure. Apologies for the delay." I'll refine.

ciso-karla: follow-ups: 1) infra to restrict terraform automation so it doesn't remove decrypter role without a runway/approval, 2) engineering to implement retry + DLQ + correlation ids, 3) security to create an automated alert when DSAR jobs have partial deletes.

zoe: filing infra PR to add a guard and a manual approval step for KMS SA role removals. filing erasure ticket for retries and log correlation.

samir: closing loop: evidence bundle uploaded to secure drive with KMS audit query, job logs, ledger exports. tagging legal/infosec. thanks all.

ciso-karla: appreciate quick response. please include mitigation timeline in the postmortem.

legal-michelle: will hold customer note until postmortem draft is ready.

samir: will draft a short postmortem and attach it to the ticket.
